pricingNote: Checked 2026-10-16 on ampcode.com/docs/pricing. Hobby is Free: pay-as-you-go orbs, or your own runners for free, plus ChatGPT, Claude, and other subscriptions, BYOK, and no Amp token fees or limits. The Individual card has two prices. Megawatt is $20 a month and includes 45,000 minutes of orb time. Gigawatt is $200 a month and includes 480,000 minutes of orb time. Teams is no extra charge. Enterprise is Custom. Included usage resets each month and does not roll over. Past the included agent usage you buy credits; for individuals and non-enterprise workspaces Amp does not mark up provider API prices, and non-model tools such as web search also consume credits. Purchased credits expire twelve months after purchase. The page does not print a token count for included agent usage, so none is shown. A per-minute orb rate beyond the included minutes was not on this page, so none is shown.
